meta.description:
Welcome to the Official YouTube channel for Bluey!

Bluey is lovable and energetic Blue Heeler puppy who lives with her Mum, Dad and little sister Bingo. She uses her limitless energy and imagination to discover, laugh and play with all her friends and family!
 
Join Bluey, Bingo, Bandit and Chilli on all their adventures!

Created by Ludo Studio 
© Ludo Studio

🐾  Subscribe for all the latest fro
